common.offline: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: To see and download everything that was shared.
signIn.noPassword: No password yet? Set one in the app under Settings › Password, or ask for an invite.
signIn.pinInstead: Only sending? Enter a PIN instead
signIn.wrongLeft.one: Wrong username or password. 1 try left.
signIn.wrongLeft.other: Wrong username or password. {n} tries left.
signIn.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {time}.
signIn.noCookie: This browser didn't keep the sign-in. Allow cookies for this site and try again.
signIn.signedOut: This browser was signed out. Sign in again.
settings.signedInAtHome: Signed in at home: this works only on the home network
settings.passwordNone: None yet: set one to sign in on other phones and computers
about.title: About Share
about.madeWith: Made with Preact, Uppy and lean-qr (MIT License), the fonts Roboto, Noto Serif and Roboto Mono (SIL Open Font License 1.1), and Lucide icons (ISC License).
theme.autoDetail: Linen by day, Ember at night
devices.title: Your phones and browsers
devices.lead: Where you're signed in. Sign out a phone or browser you no longer use, or one on someone else's computer.
devices.signOutBody: To come back it needs a new invite or the password.
password.lead: For signing in on other phones and computers, also without an invite.
password.wrongLeft.one: The current password is wrong. 1 try left.
password.wrongLeft.other: The current password is wrong. {n} tries left.
password.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {time}.
password.usernameBad: 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.body: Sign out of this browser? You can come back with an invite or your password.
delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.body: All your phones and browsers get signed out. The files you sent stay for everyone.
delete.lastAdmin: You're the only admin. Make someone else admin first.
library.empty: Nothing here yet. What people send shows up here, by the day it arrived.
send.lead: No PIN needed while you're signed in. Everything arrives unchanged, in full quality.
send.noPinNeeded: You're signed in, so no PIN is needed.
send.noFolder: You don't see any folder yet, so there's nowhere to send to. An admin gives you folders.
send.folderGone: A folder files were going into is gone. Choose another one and try again.
folders.title: Folders
folders.personSees: {name} sees only the folders switched on. Admins see every folder.
folders.lead: Everyone sees only the folders they were given; admins see all of them.
folders.name: Name
folders.newHelp: Only admins see it until you give it to people.
folders.noPins: No PIN sends into this folder.
folders.renameHelp: Its folder on the server's drive gets the new name too.
folders.deleteBody: Its files go to Recently deleted, and restoring one brings the folder back. PINs that send into it stop working.
folders.gone: This folder doesn't exist any more.
folders.nameBad: A folder needs a name, and it can't be a date like 2026-09-27.
folders.busy: The folder's files are still moving after its last rename. Try again in a few minutes.
folders.lastFolder: The last folder can't be deleted: everything is sent into a folder.
viewer.noPreview: No preview for this file. Download it to open it.
viewer.cantShow: This browser can't show this photo. Download it to see it.
viewer.cantPlay: This browser can't play this video. Download it to watch it.
select.tipTouch: Tap a day's circle to select all of it. Long-press and drag to select many at once.
select.tipMouse: Click a day's circle to select all of it. Shift-click selects everything in between.
delete.filesBody: They'll be gone for everyone. For {days} days you can still bring them back from Recently deleted.
zip.started: Downloading {n} files as one ZIP, {size}. Your browser shows how far it is.
zip.tooMany: That's more than 10,000 files. Download them a few days at a time.
zip.busy: Two downloads are already running. Try again when one is done.
share.tooMany: Share up to 10 files, 50 MB, at once. Download the rest instead.
save.title: Download {n} files · {size}
save.folderDetail: Into “{folder}”, a folder for each day. Files already there are skipped.
save.folderNew: You pick the folder next; in it, a folder for each day. Files already there are skipped.
save.cantPick: This browser can't save into that folder. Choose another one, or download a ZIP.
save.perDay: A folder for each day, as on the server
save.keepOpen: Keep this tab open until it's done.
save.skipped.one: 1 file was already in the folder, so it's skipped.
save.skipped.other: {n} files were already in the folder, so they're skipped.
save.waiting: No connection. Saving goes on by itself when there is one again.
save.failed.one: 1 file couldn't be saved: it isn't on the server any more.
save.failed.other: {n} files couldn't be saved: they aren't on the server any more.
save.full: The drive is full. Make some room, then save again: what's there already is skipped.
save.folderGone: The folder can't be written to any more. Save again and choose it once more.
pins.title: Upload PINs
pins.lead: A PIN only lets people send. Nobody can see or download anything with it.
pins.leadShows: A PIN lets people send into its folder. Only PINs made to show their folder let guests see it too.
pins.guestsSeeHelp: Everyone with the PIN then sees and downloads what is in it, as at a wedding.
pins.none: No PINs yet. Make one, and everyone you give it to can send you files.
pins.newCodeBody: The old code stops working at once, also in links you already sent.
pins.endBody: Nobody can send with it any more. What was sent stays in the library.
pins.madeUp: Made up for you. You can also type your own.
pins.badCode: A PIN has 5 letters or numbers, without 0, O, 1 and I.
pins.taken: That PIN was used before. Pick another one.
pins.shareText: Send me photos and files with Share: {link}
pins.madeCopied: PIN {code} is ready, and its link is copied.
people.title: People
people.removeBody: Their phones and browsers are signed out. The files they sent stay in the library.
people.lastAdmin: This is the only admin. Make someone else admin first.
people.inviteForDevice: For another phone or browser of {name}
people.newPasswordFirst: For signing in on other phones and in browsers
newPassword.title: New password for {name}
newPassword.lead: Share makes up a password for this username. The phones and browsers of {name} stay signed in.
newPassword.shownOnce: Shown only now. Hand it to {name} in person or in a private message; it can be changed in Settings.
invite.title: Invite someone
invite.roleHelp: Members see, download and send. Admins can also delete files, manage PINs and invite people.
invite.scanThis: Let {name} scan this with the phone camera, or send the link to open in a browser.
invite.deviceLead: Scan this with the new phone, or open the link in the new browser. It signs in as {name}.
invite.shareText: {name}, this invite signs you in to Share. It works once, for 24 hours: {link}
invite.qrLabel: QR code of the invite for {name}
trash.title: Recently deleted
trash.lead: Deleted files stay here for {days} days. Then they're gone for good.
storage.title: Storage
storage.setOnServer: Set in config.json on the server
storage.warn.marker_missing: The drive isn't mounted, or Share's storage folder was never set up (share init).
storage.warn.storage_unreadable: The storage folder can't be read.
storage.warn.folder_missing: Folders inside the storage folder are missing. Run share init on the server.
storage.warn.other_drive: Parts of the storage folder are on another drive, so uploads can't finish.
storage.warn.not_a_drive: The files are in the router's memory or flash, not on a drive.
storage.warn.data_unreadable: The data folder, with the database and thumbnails, can't be read.
storage.warn.data_unsafe: The database is on a network or FUSE drive, where it isn't safe. Set data_dir to a local disk.
storage.warn.data_in_memory: The database is in memory and would be lost when the server restarts.
storage.warn.drive_full: The drive is full: uploads have stopped. Make some room, for example by emptying Recently deleted.
storage.warn.fat32: The drive is FAT32: files over 4 GB can't be stored.
storage.warn.ignores_case: The drive is exFAT or NTFS: it ignores capitals in names and is slower than ext4.
storage.warn.low_space: Less than 1 GB is left before uploads stop.
storage.warn.unknown: The server found something to look at. Run share check there.
